newsitem.title: USA: Millipore faces fine by Puerto Rican agency.
newsitem.headline: Millipore faces fine by Puerto Rican agency.

text.p: Millipore Corp said Monday the Environmental Quality Board of Puerto Rico proposes a fine of $96.5 million against its Millipore Cidra Inc unit and alleges that membrane scrap discarded during the production of the unit's nitrocellulose-based membrane is hazardous waste.
The company said that tests performed in accordance with U.S. Environmental Protection Agency regulations show that such waste is not hazardous.
The company said it expects to achieve a favorable resolution of this issue.
Millipore said it was served the administrative order on Friday by the board.
